thesis: A high-return, unlevered core-banking franchise with recovering rolling returns and raised guidance trades below its own 5-year median multiples, but its price already implies growth above the company's framework.
reason: Quality is high and improving and the stock is cheap on its own history, but the cash-flow fair value sits well below the price and the reverse DCF needs growth above the 8% framework. The scorecard keeps conviction at 3: hold at the current size, which is at the conviction-3 level; no add.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
TTM operating margin falls below 22%, under the FY2024 low of 22.1%, showing cloud/AI/security investment or renewal pricing is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the rising trend (TTM 27.6%).
Organic revenue growth (10-Q MD&A, ex-deconversion) turns negative, processing revenue growth falls below 5% for two consecutive quarters, or core client losses outnumber wins.
